 :: Before ::
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Parthivjyoti Saikia
Heard the learned counsel Mr. M.H. Ahmed appearing for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr.
R.J. Baruah, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor Page No.# 2/3 representing the State of Assam.

This is an application under Section 439 of the CrPC filed by the petitioner Billal Hussain praying for releasing him on bail after he was arrested in connection with Paltanbazar P.S. Case Billal Hussain vs The State Of Assam on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177995298/
1 No.502/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/457/386/352/420 of the IPC.
On 14.11.2023, Sri Avinash Kumar Apurw lodged an FIR before police alleging that he belongs to the state of Bihar and prior to lodging of the FIR, for a period of three months he was in telephonic contact with Biki Ali and the present petitioner who allegedly wanted to sell gold to him.
Therefore, on 4th November, 2023, he came down to Guwahati and stayed in a hotel at Paltanbazar.

entities.text: Paltanbazar P.S. Case Billal Hussain vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Biki Ali and the present petitioner Billal Hussain went to his room and snatched away a cash amount of 4 lakhs from him along with his mobile phone.
The case diary reveals that Avinash Kumar Apurw purchased the gold for an amount of 12 lakhs and an amount of 4 lakhs was given to the Biki Ali and the present petitioner, as advance.
But subsequently, the informant Avinash Kumar Apurw discovered that the gold he purchased was fake gold.
Thereafter, he had lodged the FIR before police.
After going through the case diary, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioner does not deserve to be detained in custody any further period of time.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

The petitioner Billal Hussain is allowed to go on bail in connection with Paltanbazar P.S. Case No.502/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/457/386/352/420 of the IPC on furnishing bail bond of 25,000/-
Page No.# 3/3 with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup(M), Guwahati, Assam.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup(M), Guwahati, Assam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The bail application is disposed of.
